Ankle-brachial pressure index (ABPI, ABI): the highest systolic pressure measured at the ankle divided by the highest systolic pressure measured in either arm. Unitless. Number of apneas plus hypopneas per hour of sleep, used to diagnose and grade sleep apnea. Use when the source counts apneas and hypopneas only; the Respiratory Disturbance Index (which adds respiratory effort-related arousals) is a separate concept.
Concentration of AST/SGOT in blood. AST (aspartate aminotransferase), also known as SGOT (Serum Glutamic Oxaloacetic Transaminase), is typically measured in serum or plasma.

Average arterial pressure throughout one cardiac cycle (MAP), usually diastolic pressure plus one third of pulse pressure when not measured directly.

Volume of coronary artery calcium from CT (the volume score), in mm3. Not the Agatston score (CAC score) and not Hounsfield units, which measure attenuation. The code (OMOP:4166120) is a generic 'Calcium volume'.

Thickness of the carotid intima-media complex (intima plus media, typically the far wall), in mm. Use for the intima-media complex; use Carotid artery thickness for total wall thickness.

Thickness of the carotid artery wall segment (total wall, not only the intima-media complex), in mm. Use when the source measures total wall or does not say intima-media; use Carotid IMT for the intima-media complex. Segment and side go in body_site/qualifier.
